purpose: Separate the attack-variant effect from the seed/order effect on backdoor timing. Only A1 (no-defense) arms with the truth curve every 10 steps. No defence code runs.

existing_points.A/1101: asr-defense-toy r02 (160-step run): trigger jump 37->39; normal task V60>=48 first at step 137

predictions_before_running.a1_A_s1102: trigger hits > 3/60 at or before step 50; first poison row with loss < 0.05 is consumed before the 20-step median row loss drops below 1.0
predictions_before_running.a1_B_s1101: trigger hits <= 3/60 until after the median row loss is below 1.0; the rise from <=3 to >=57 spans >= 30 steps

decision_rule: Both predictions hold -> timing is a property of the attack target; go to step 2 (intermediate target). Both fail or mixed -> the variant explanation is withdrawn; step 2 is redesigned around data order (XO-style) before any further defence work.
cost: 2 x ~20 min GPU1 + ~1 min CPU preparation
